IT is hereby notified that the road described in the Schedule below has been named “Wasana Place” by the Minister incharge of the subject of Local Government of the Western Provincial Council, under Section 71(1) of Chapter 252 of theMunicipal Council Ordinance to be read with Section 2 of the Provincial Councils (Consequential Provisions) Act, No. 12of 1989.

(i) Beginning of the road-

Left side : Property bearing Assessment No. 22 on the right side of he Malabe Thalahena Bathalawattaroad ;Right side : Property bearing Assessment No. 18 on the right side of the Malabe Thalahena Bathalawattaroad
